TWO_STAGE_50_50_CONFIRM5.description: Commit half initially and half on the first executable pre-add ROI >=5%; then sell all at TP20, SL20, or 120 seconds.

TEACHER_ACTION_REPLAY.description: Replay teacher post-decision buy/sell fractions only where teacher identity, inventory baseline, and every leg are exactly reconstructable; otherwise exclude.
